Activating (starts sending emails/changing data) has no confirm.
Two places with save-like controls: toolbar 'Speichern' and header 'Aktivieren'.
Many NativeSelects with up to 200 records each instead of server-searching pickers (app.md).
Delete step only via keyboard (Backspace/Delete) or inspector; no touch-friendly path on the canvas.
Trashed workflows have no trash view to restore from.
